publisher: Lu Ming trading as Shane Game
intro: Build your store, serve your customers, and grow your business.
description:
Build your own grocery store, stock the shelves, set competitive prices, and keep your customers happy.

Manage daily operations, serve shoppers, upgrade your store, and turn a small local shop into a successful supermarket.

In Supermarket Simulator - Grocery Store, every decision shapes your business. Customize your layout, organize products, manage inventory, hire staff, and improve your store as you grow. Start with basic equipment and limited resources, then expand your supermarket and create a thriving retail business.

Key Features:

● Manage every aspect of your own supermarket
● Customize your store layout and organize products efficiently
● Order stock, manage inventory, and set competitive prices
● Operate the checkout with scanning and customer payments
● Expand and upgrade your store as your business grows
● Hire staff and automate daily tasks
● Build your business through smart decisions and efficient management

Take control of your store, keep your customers coming back, and turn your small grocery shop into a successful supermarket. Make smart investments, improve your operations, and watch your business grow from a simple local store into a thriving retail destination.
